reviewed_scope: Independent static source review of the conditional AllThree CPU verifier template, renderer, root-preparation contract, seven-file private-import staging boundary, and support-launch producer/consumer identity. This review does not authorize or report body rendering, B staging, verifier execution, terminal acceptance, or a fit result.

required_bindings: exact seven-code dependency list, paths, byte lengths, and hashes
checker source review with PASS_SOURCE_ONLY and the exact checker pin
unique bounded metadata_and_proof_pins including original AllThree/NLL anchors and all fourteen accepted predecessor receipts
readonly_ancestry_receipt_sha256 exactly equal to the fourteen named receipt hashes
accepted_import_boundary_proof with its exact path, byte length, hash, code closure, no-preload, bytecode, and entrypoint fields
this conditional source review plus exact wrapper-template and renderer pins
root_preparation_contract.acyclicity: This source review binds the checker, helper/proof artifacts, wrapper template, renderer, and source metadata only. It does not bind a ROOT_PREPARATION hash, actual native terminal evidence, or rendered body. Root preparation can therefore pin this review without a cycle; the renderer later reads root preparation and separately joins the actual typed native evidence to its raw-first capture before writing the body.

native_terminal_gate.raw_join: The renderer reads the exact terminal JSON and raw-first capture with bounded no-follow stable reads, requires positive raw byte count equal to the captured raw bytes, recomputes and matches SHA-256, checks the canonical raw path and exact run/unit/invocation, and joins captured_utc and unit properties (including Result=success). It requires timezone-qualified ordered terminal timestamps. The worker repeats the native/raw join before fresh B-side preflight.

predecessor_receipts.nll_role: accepted, exactly stopped sequential predecessor; AllThree initializer remains parent ep3

worker_import_controls: all seven staged .py files are stable no-follow prehashed before imports
fresh output directory begins absent and contains only staged pinned files before import
reject any __pycache__ directory or .pyc before and after import
reject any of the seven private module names already in sys.modules
run literal project interpreter with -E -B -I, set sys.dont_write_bytecode=True and sys.pycache_prefix=None
verify exact post-import origins, helper closure, and all seven hashes again
call assert_helper_closure then the 13-Path verify_terminal API; no CLI/main/old verifier entrypoint
private_code_and_checker_contract.restricted_state_loading: The wrapper preserves the checker’s weights_only=True bounded loads and exact dictionary-path Path decoder; no unsafe weights_only=False or generic Path decoder is introduced.

fresh_preflight_before_output_mutation.mutation_boundary: Embedded payload pins and all preflight checks precede D.mkdir; D must be absent and the support unit must be not-found. Admission and staged files are created only after fresh gates pass.
fresh_preflight_before_output_mutation.source_and_data: Rehash exact 167-file source tree/manifest and canonical split; validate registered data paths by identity and stat only; terminal run artifacts are exact-inventory, size-capped stat-only checks.
fresh_preflight_before_output_mutation.cache_and_dictionary: Verify accepted cache receipts, metadata and array identity/stat receipts without reading or hashing array payloads. Parent checkpoint and dictionary are checked by accepted identity and stat only.
fresh_preflight_before_output_mutation.predecessors: Read-only exact hash checks for all fourteen accepted acceptance/exact-stop receipts plus profile metadata; no receipt restaging or source/cache mutation.
fresh_preflight_before_output_mutation.native_unit: Fresh systemd show must still match the captured AllThree invocation and active/exited, PID 0, ExecMainCode 1, ExecMainStatus 0, Result success; CPUUsageNSec must be positive and live unit.log must equal raw capture content.

resource_envelope.scratch: direct physical research_tmp on same device 64512, ext4, at least 25 GiB free

selected_gpu.foreign_owners: read-only identity snapshot; preserve with no process action

support_submission_contract.attempt_policy: One systemd-run submission call only. On timeout, OS error, missing support invocation, query failure, or nonzero result, persist the outcome when possible, fail closed, and never retry or recreate the output directory.
support_submission_contract.result_consumer: The existing capture template requires the actual support invocation ID and exact support unit, plus matching native_unit/native_invocation_id in admission and launch, then rechecks the live support invocation.

nonblocking_limitations: The renderer and worker gate validate every fixed typed-native field, strict integer values, canonical raw path, byte count, digest, capture identity, and timestamp ordering, but do not themselves reject additional JSON keys. The frozen checker requires the exact 14-key schema; root’s separate exact-key pre-admission audit must remain in force, as planned, so extra keys cannot reach actual verifier admission or be accepted.

The import proof is focused and local: it establishes the seven-file origin/hash and guarded import boundary, not exhaustive OS-level I/O confinement or worker runtime. Local Torch 2.14.1 is not proof of worker Torch 2.14.0+cu130.

local_check_history.author_report: LOCAL_CHECKS.md reports 15 focused synthetic tests and Ruff check/format passed, including typed/raw mismatches, strict integer and timestamp fields, exact import-proof/preload contract, launch producer/consumer identity, API Path arguments, and preflight/GPU/output mutation ordering. It also records a readiness-only render check with no body and no B action.
local_check_history.reviewer_execution: The independent reviewer read the final pinned source and fixtures only. No tests, imports, renderer command, B query, native capture, model/state/data/cache payload read, or body render was performed.

conditions_and_limitations: This conditional review binds final source bytes and the static checker review/proof contract only. It intentionally does not bind a ROOT_PREPARATION hash, actual typed native evidence, raw capture bytes, or rendered body hash; root preparation and native evidence are created/bound later in the acyclic flow.

PASS_CONDITIONAL_SOURCE_ONLY does not stage/admit/execute the support worker, accept a terminal result, establish fit quality, stop any unit, or authorize publication. Root must create the exact local-only root preparation and separately require a matching strict native typed/raw capture before rendering; root owns actual body review, admission, support result capture, acceptance, and exact stop.
The captured AllThree run was previously observed active/running at the latest health sample. This static review makes no claim that it has exited or that terminal evidence exists.
